name: tw-stock-etf-advisor
description: Taiwan ETF / stock research, buy-sell decisions, personal holdings tracking, and K-line charting. Finds common holdings between ETFs (e.g. 0050 / 0052), recommends what to buy and why with an entry/exit plan from a live quote, records the trades you make, reviews your holdings to suggest what to sell, and draws a standalone Tokyo-Night candlestick chart that marks why each buy/sell/hold happened — with forward ⚑ signal lines for watchlist triggers and a post-mortem review panel logging every decision (status, condition, outcome). Persists price history + decision markers in a local SQLite DB. Always fetches live data via agent-browser; never guesses or derives prices.
